gloss: to cram; to stuff; to pack in

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {詰|つ}め{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {詰|つ}め{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {詰|つ}め{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To force many things into a limited space.
To memorize large amounts of information in a short time.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I stuffed the luggage into the suitcase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to cram students into a classroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧も{詰|つ}め{込|こ}んで⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We crammed five people into a small car and set off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To cram knowledge into one's head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}んでも、すぐ⟦{忘|わす}れてしまう→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you cram knowledge before an exam, you'll forget it quickly.

examples.japanese: {詰|つ}め{込|こ}み⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ではなく、⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Rather than cramming-style education, education that nurtures the ability to think is being called for.

notes:
{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to pack) + 込む (into). It implies forcing things in beyond comfortable capacity.

ASPECT (ている):
{詰|つ}め{込|こ}んでいる indicates the state of being crammed full.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [things]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[space]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む — to cram [things] into [space]
- [knowledge]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む — to cram [knowledge] into one's head
- ⟦{鞄|かばん}→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む (stuff into a bag)
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{詰|つ}め{込|こ}む (cram knowledge)
- {詰|つ}め{込|こ}み⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (cramming-style education)

EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT:
{詰|つ}め{込|こ}み{教育|きょういく} refers to rote memorization education, often criticized as superficial learning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to pack (neutral)
- ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}む→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧: to push/force in
- {詰|つ}め{込|こ}む: to cram (implies excess)
